scenarios.title_zh: x402 Python MCP 重试二次审批、计费失败取消、Facilitator 凭证托管与 skipHandler 前置结算合规基线
scenarios.title_en: x402 Python MCP Retry Re-Approval, Cancel-on-Calc-Failure, Facilitator Voucher Custody & skipHandler Settle Baseline
scenarios.question_zh: Python MCP 支付重试重新执行审批，用量计费失败尝试取消并保留工具输出，且 Facilitator 托管凭证与 skipHandler 前置结算均正常执行时，护栏是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should the guard admit a flow where Python MCP payment retries re-run approval, calc failures attempt cancel while preserving tool output, and facilitator voucher custody passes?
scenarios.detail: x402 voucher custody, builder-code metadata `m`, skipHandler settlement, gate fail-closed, and RFC 8785 JCS verified

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Python MCP 支付重试跳过审批或用量计算失败默认按上限扣款（#3735）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Python MCP Payment Retry Bypassing Approval or Charging maxAmount on Calc Failure (#3735)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Python MCP 支付重试绕过二次审批，或用量计费失败时未取消而是默认按 `maxAmount` 扣款时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block a Python MCP payment retry that skips approval or falls back to charging maxAmount when usage calculation fails (#3735)?
scenarios.detail: Usage-charge calculation failure must attempt cancellation rather than charging maxAmount (#3735)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 阻断上限乱扣款
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block maxAmount fallback

scenarios.title_zh: x402 处理器失败时跳过 Facilitator 凭证 `SettleOnCancel` 或接受客户端 `m` 元数据（#3726/#3723）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Skipping Facilitator Voucher `SettleOnCancel` on Handler Failure or Accepting Client `m` Metadata (#3726/#3723)
scenarios.question_zh: 当客户端载荷伪造 ERC-8021 `m` 结算元数据被采信，或 `SettleOnCancel` 未触发时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block a request that honors client-supplied builder-code `m` metadata or skips `SettleOnCancel` (#3726/#3723)?
scenarios.detail: Client-supplied builder-code settlement metadata `m` must be ignored (#3723/#3711)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 忽略客户端 m 元数据
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Ignore client m metadata

scenarios.title_zh: x402 `onAfterVerify` 返回 `skipHandler` 绕过前置结算直接返回 200（#3718）
scenarios.question_zh: 在 `upfront` 前置结算流程中，`onAfterVerify` 返回 `skipHandler` 时若跳过前置结算白送响应，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block `skipHandler` when it skips the before-handler settle on an upfront payment flow (#3718)?
scenarios.detail: onAfterVerify skipHandler must still execute before-handler settle on upfront flows (#3718)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 阻断未结算放行
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block unsettled skipHandler

scenarios.title_zh: x402 `beforeVerify`/`beforeSettle` 门禁钩子抛异常时 Fail-Open 或 `offer-receipt` 违反 RFC 8785（#3702/#3700）
scenarios.title_en: x402 `beforeVerify`/`beforeSettle` Hook Throw Failing Open or `offer-receipt` Violating RFC 8785 (#3702/#3700)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 `beforeVerify` 门禁钩子抛出异常仅记录日志继续放行（fail-open），是否必须以 `extension_hook_error` 阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must a throwing `beforeVerify` or `beforeSettle` gate hook fail closed with `extension_hook_error` (#3702)?
scenarios.detail: Gate hook throw in beforeVerify must fail closed with extension_hook_error (#3702)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 门禁异常故障闭合
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Fail closed on hook throw

scenarios.title_zh: x402 Next.js 204 空体破坏、Axios Cookie 数组逗号拼接、Python V1 500 崩溃或客户端伪造 SVM v1 交易（#3733/#3728/#3715/#3710）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Next.js 204 Null-Body Corruption, Axios Cookie Stringify, Python V1 500 Crash, or Client SVM v1 Tx (#3733/#3728/#3715/#3710)
scenarios.question_zh: 当不可信客户端在 SVM `upto` 开通道提交 v1 交易（而非 legacy/v0）或 V1 载荷触发 500 崩溃时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block untrusted client-authored SVM `upto` v1 transactions and V1 payload 500 crashes (#3710/#3715)?
scenarios.detail: Untrusted client-authored SVM `upto` channel-open transactions must be limited to legacy/v0 (#3710)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 拦截客户端 v1 交易
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block client SVM v1 tx

scenarios.title_zh: x402 共享节点 `lnbtc` 未核对服务端签发 `payment_hash` 注册表即调用 `/settle`（#3699）
scenarios.title_en: x402 Shared-Node `lnbtc` Settling Without Server-Side Issued-Hash Registry Check (#3699)
scenarios.question_zh: 当共享托管节点上的同租户伪造发票并在未匹配资源服务端已登记 `(payment_hash, network, amount, request_hash)` 的情况下请求结算时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block a shared-node `lnbtc` settlement whose payment hash was not issued and recorded by the resource server (#3699)?
scenarios.detail: Shared-node lnbtc requires server-side issued (payment_hash, network, amount, request_hash) verification before /settle (#3699)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 阻断同租户伪造发票
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block unissued lnbtc hash

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 状态绑定 Cart Offer、资源绑定与参与方鉴权分离及 Location 可用性/空间关系合规基线（#773/#762/#766/#765/#753）
scenarios.title_en: UCP State-Bound Cart Offer, Resource Binding vs. Participant Auth, and Location Availability/Spatial Baseline (#773/#762/#766/#765/#753)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Cart Offer 位于 `actions` 映射并绑定 `(cart_id, state_ref)`、Rule 1 仅比对 `(type, id)` 且 Location 具备自描述设施与根级空间关系时，是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should the guard admit a compliant UCP flow with state-bound Cart Offers in `actions`, separated binding/auth checks, and valid Location semantics?
scenarios.detail: UCP state-bound Cart Offer, resource binding vs participant auth, Location availability/amenities/spatial, and validator verified

scenarios.title_zh: UCP Cart Offer 使用平行 `offers.available[]` 载体或 `applies_to.state_ref` 失配（#773）
scenarios.title_en: UCP Cart Offer Using Parallel `offers.available[]` Carrier or Stale `applies_to.state_ref` (#773)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Cart Offer 未复用 `actions` 原语而是引入平行 `offers.available[]` 或绑定过期购物车状态时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block a Cart Offer that uses a parallel `offers.available[]` array or mismatches the current `state_ref` (#773)?
scenarios.detail: Cart Offer extension must reside in Cart `actions` map rather than `offers.available[]` (#773)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 阻断平行 Offer 载体
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block parallel Offer carrier

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 解牌 Rule 1 将 `binding.identity` 混入重放相等比对导致商户直连解牌失败（#762）
scenarios.title_en: UCP Detokenization Rule 1 Conflating `binding.identity` With Resource Replay Equality (#762)
scenarios.question_zh: 当解牌 Rule 1 错误要求比对 `identity`（而非仅比对资源 `type` 与 `id`），导致直接调用的商户因省略 `identity` 被拒时，是否拦截该错误规则？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block a Rule 1 implementation that conflates resource replay equality `(type, id)` with participant `identity` (#762)?
scenarios.detail: Binding Rule 1 must compare only (type, id) and must not fail when direct Business detokenization omits identity (#762)
scenarios.action_zh: Confirm · 分离资源绑定与参与方鉴权

scenarios.title_zh: UCP Location 使用旧版 `filters.inventory`、自定义设施缺少描述或将 `distance`/`serves` 塞入 `filters.geo`（#766/#765/#753）
scenarios.title_en: UCP Location Using Legacy `filters.inventory`, Undescribed Amenity, or `filters.geo` Spatial Relations (#766/#765/#753)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Location 检索把 `distance`/`serves` 塞进 `filters.geo` 或 Lookup 响应缺失 `inputs[]` 关联时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block Location requests that nest `distance`/`serves` under `filters.geo` or omit `inputs[]` correlation on Lookup (#753)?
scenarios.detail: `distance` and `serves` must be root-level relations (not `filters.geo`) and Lookup must return `inputs[]` correlation (#753)
scenarios.action_zh: Confirm · 强制根级空间关系与 inputs[]

scenarios.title_zh: UCP 示例注解拼写错误 `skiped` 静默跳过校验或缺少非空 `reason`（#767/#774）
scenarios.title_en: UCP Example Annotation Typo `skiped` Silently Disabling Validation or Missing `reason` (#767/#774)
scenarios.question_zh: 当文档示例注解因前缀匹配将 `skiped` 静默当成跳过校验或未提供非空 `reason` 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the validator reject non-whole-word `skip` typos (`skiped`) and empty `reason` attributes (#767)?
scenarios.detail: Example annotation must use whole-word `skip` with a non-empty `reason` (#767)
scenarios.action_zh: Confirm · 拦截静默跳过注解

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe 付费工具清理、MCP `ToolFailure` + 序列会话句柄与 $\tau$-bench 2.0 护栏合规基线（#412/#3312/#3318/#548/#533/#562）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe Paid-Tool Removal, MCP `ToolFailure` + Sequenced Handle & tau2-bench Guard Baseline (#412/#3312/#3318/#548/#533/#562)
scenarios.question_zh: 当移除废弃 `registerPaidTool`、携带合规 `CallToolResult._meta.toolFailure` 与单调 `seq` 会话句柄、且 $\tau$-bench 正确处理越界中止与围栏 JSON 时，是否放行？
scenarios.question_en: Should the guard admit a compliant flow with `ToolFailure` metadata, monotonic MAC-verified conversation handle, and valid tau2-bench evaluation?
scenarios.detail: Stripe paid-tool removal, MCP ToolFailure + conversation handle, and tau2-bench abort/checkpoint/judge/live-voice guards verified

scenarios.title_zh: Stripe AI 调用已废弃 `registerPaidTool` 或 MCP `ToolFailure` 缺失 `correlationId`（#412/#3312/#3313）
scenarios.title_en: Stripe AI Using Removed `registerPaidTool` or MCP `ToolFailure` Missing `correlationId` (#412/#3312/#3313)
scenarios.question_zh: 当代码仍引用已移除的 `registerPaidTool` / `experimental_PaidMcpAgent` 或 `ToolFailure` 缺少 `correlationId` 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block deprecated `registerPaidTool` usage or an invalid `io.modelcontextprotocol/toolFailure` payload (#412/#3312)?
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 拦截废弃付费工具接口
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Block removed registerPaidTool

scenarios.title_zh: MCP 会话句柄 `seq` 回退重放或 Sierra $\tau$-bench `###OUT-OF-SCOPE###` 中止被误记为 `USER_STOP` 获得非零奖励（#3318/#548）
scenarios.title_en: MCP Conversation Handle `seq` Replay or Sierra tau2-bench `###OUT-OF-SCOPE###` Abort Graded as `USER_STOP` (#3318/#548)
scenarios.question_zh: 当用户模拟器发出 `###OUT-OF-SCOPE###` 放弃仿真却被记为正常 `USER_STOP` 并获得正奖励时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block grading a `###OUT-OF-SCOPE###` simulator abort as `USER_STOP` with non-zero reward (#548)?
scenarios.detail: ###OUT-OF-SCOPE### simulator abort must record its own termination reason and receive 0.0 reward (#548)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 越界中止强制零分
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Enforce 0 reward on abort

scenarios.title_zh: Sierra $\tau$-bench 替换轨迹写入完成前提前删除旧 Checkpoint 导致数据丢失，或将语音 `speech_started` 误标为 `was_truncated`（#533/#528）
scenarios.title_en: Sierra tau2-bench Unlinking Previous Checkpoint Before Replacement Write Completes or Conflating `speech_started` With `was_truncated` (#533/#528)
scenarios.question_zh: 当 Checkpoint 替换在新文件完成序列化与 `os.replace` 前就删除旧轨迹文件，或把语音 `speech_started` 误标为 `was_truncated` 时，是否阻断？
scenarios.question_en: Must the guard block unlinking the previous checkpoint trajectory before replacement write completion or setting `was_truncated` on `speech_started` (#533/#528)?
scenarios.detail: Checkpoint replacement must not unlink previous trajectory before replacement write + os.replace completes (#533)
scenarios.action_zh: Send to a human · 保护旧 Checkpoint 轨迹
scenarios.action_en: Send to a human · Preserve old checkpoint
